response: {"thought": "依定義，取消率以台北時間（UTC+8）的訂單成立月份歸屬，分子為狀態 9，分母為狀態 1、2、3、9。先用 SQL 計算 2025-11 的各狀態筆數與比率。", "tool": "sql_query", "args": {"query": "SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN status = 9 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cancelled, SUM(CASE WHEN status IN (1,2,3) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS valid, COUNT(*) AS total_in_scope, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN status = 9 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / SUM(CASE WHEN status IN (1,2,3,9) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 2) AS cancel_rate_pct FROM orders WHERE strftime('%Y-%m', datetime(order_ts, '+8 hours')) = '2025-11' AND status IN (1,2,3,9)"}}
